name: Governance Branch Review
description: Governance-aware adaptive review of the current branch versus a base ref: maps changes, fans out ACGS-Lite-specific dimension reviewers, adversarially verifies findings, and emits a constitutional-invariant scorecard.

metadata.trigger: Reviewing ACGS-Lite branch changes before a PR
metadata.purpose: Catch governance regressions and optional-integration risks in a branch before it reaches a PR.
metadata.scope: Read-only review of the current branch's diff vs a base ref. May write a review report; must not mutate source or git history.
failure_modes: dirty unrelated changes -> scope to diff only

name: Verify Governance Fixes
description: Adversarially verifies that applied governance fixes actually close their findings by writing and executing concrete bypass attempts against the installed code.

metadata.purpose: Prove a security-bearing fix resists a real bypass attempt, not just that unit tests pass.
metadata.scope: Writes and executes bypass attempts against installed code in the project .venv. Test-only; must not alter production source.
inputs: the applied fixes / findings to verify
outputs: per-fix held/defeated verdict with the executed bypass attempt
safety_constraints: run bypass code in an isolated test context
never commit bypass scaffolding to source
failure_modes: fix defeated -> report and reopen the finding

name: Security Review
description: Reviews code for exploitable vulnerabilities, input validation gaps, auth/authz issues, hardcoded secrets, and OWASP concerns.

metadata.purpose: Surface exploitable vulnerabilities and insecure patterns before merge.
metadata.scope: Read-only audit of the diff and adjacent code. Reports findings; does not apply fixes.
outputs: ranked security findings with severity and remediation
safety_constraints: never include working exploit payloads against third parties
failure_modes: no diff -> review HEAD against main

name: Code Review
description: Structured code review using tiered persona agents, confidence-gated findings, and a merge/dedup pipeline for changes before a PR.

metadata.purpose: General correctness/maintainability/testing review of a change before a PR.
metadata.scope: Read-only review of the current diff. Emits findings; may post PR comments when asked.
safety_constraints: do not apply changes unless explicitly asked

name: Technical Planning
description: Creates structured implementation plans for multi-step software features: decisions, files, dependencies, and enumerated test scenarios.

metadata.purpose: Turn a feature request into a concrete, reviewable implementation plan before code is written.
metadata.scope: Read-only exploration + plan authoring. Produces a plan document; writes no source.
outputs: step-by-step plan with critical files and test scenarios
safety_constraints: surface architectural conflicts rather than guessing

name: Debug
description: Systematically finds root causes and fixes bugs: reproduces failures, traces errors, and investigates test failures or issue-tracker reports.

metadata.purpose: Find the root cause of a failing test or reported bug and fix it.
metadata.scope: May edit source to fix the identified root cause; must add or update a covering test.
inputs: failing test / stack trace / issue reference
safety_constraints: no broad refactors under a bug fix
failure_modes: cannot reproduce -> gather more signal before changing code

name: Researcher
description: Gathers external and in-repo context for a question (web search, docs, codebase), adversarially verifies claims, and returns a cited synthesis.

metadata.purpose: Produce grounded, cited context before a decision or implementation.
metadata.scope: Read-only. Writes a research note only; never edits source.
outputs: cited research note with verified claims
safety_constraints: flag unverifiable claims rather than asserting them
failure_modes: question underspecified -> narrow scope before researching

name: Coder
description: Implements a planned change in the ACGS-Lite codebase, following repo conventions, and proves it with the verification ladder before handing off.

metadata.purpose: Carry an approved plan to working, verified code.
metadata.scope: Edits src/ and tests/ within the approved plan. Must not weaken governance defaults or bypass MACI.
safety_constraints: no SDK imports at module import time
failure_modes: verify fails -> fix before handoff, do not mark complete

name: Docs
description: Writes and maintains documentation (root docs, docs/ site, runbooks) and keeps it building and link-clean.

metadata.purpose: Keep the repo self-describing: accurate docs that build and whose links resolve.
metadata.scope: Edits *.md and docs/. Must not change behavior; documents what exists.
inputs: a doc gap or change to document
outputs: updated docs that build and pass the link check
safety_constraints: no unsupported claims on public surfaces (see GOAL.md honesty pass)
failure_modes: broken link -> fix or remove before completing

name: Release
description: Prepares a release: builds wheel + sdist, validates the package, updates the changelog, and runs a publish dry-run.

metadata.purpose: Produce a clean, validated release artifact and verify it installs from a fresh environment.
metadata.scope: Builds and validates packages; updates CHANGELOG. Actual upload (make publish) is owner-gated.
safety_constraints: never run 'make publish' without explicit owner authorization (PyPI token, see BLOCKERS.md)
failure_modes: twine check fails -> fix metadata before publishing
